question: Can every graph edge in the three authorized C08 development worlds be converted into a continuous bidirectional spline trajectory using explicit <=0.5m graph-node connectors that remain clear of the frozen perception mesh?
method: For each sealed C08 graph, construct a deterministic Euler circuit over one directed copy of every edge in each direction. Preserve edge and tunnel identity, traverse node-to-spline connector, exact associated spline subarc and connector-to-node, sample future replay poses every 2m, and audit every connector at <=0.05m spacing using unsigned closest-surface distance on the frozen native perception mesh.
baseline: Strict zero-connector assumption that every graph node lies exactly on every incident tunnel spline; this baseline fails at S01 node_0015 with 0.361167m error. Necessary fallback is to stop and regenerate/re-audit assets if the approved <=0.5m connector or >=0.8m mesh-clearance contract fails.

user_authorization.scope: One zero-ray Gate-4 C08 trajectory mesh contract using the recommended <=0.5m explicit connector option; no C09/C10, LiDAR, inference, online graph or M-TARE.
user_authorization.confirmation_reference: User explicitly replied 批准 to recommended option A and then 继续.

acceptance_criteria: Exactly 3 C08 worlds, 3 independent trajectories, 312 graph edges and 624 directed edge traversals are preserved; every edge is traversed exactly once in each direction.
Every edge references exactly one existing tunnel spline and every explicit endpoint connector is <=0.5m.
All connector samples at <=0.05m spacing have unsigned closest-surface distance >=0.8m on the frozen perception mesh.
Exact aggregate route length is 9541.643029407867m and exact independent-world frame count at 2m spacing is 4773.
Zero LiDAR rays, inference frames, graph-runtime updates, C09/C10 reads and M-TARE changes; complete metrics, trajectories, traversals, connectors, previews, logs and evidence seal are preserved.
stop_conditions: Any frozen graph, spline, mesh, materialization, geometry parameter, code or config hash drifts.
Any edge mapping is missing/ambiguous, route is discontinuous/direction-unbalanced, connector exceeds 0.5m, or connector mesh clearance falls below 0.8m.
Any LiDAR, model inference, online graph update, C09/C10 or M-TARE access would occur.
expected_evidence: Three per-world machine metrics and one aggregate summary with exact length/frame/mapping/clearance counts.
Three trajectory NPZ files, three edge-traversal JSON files and three complete connector JSON files.
Three complete-world XY/XZ route figures, one S01 node_0015 connector detail, raw log, environment/tool/input hashes, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU/Open3D closest-surface audit only, expected under 6 minutes; zero GPU and zero rays.
